info.title: Saverlly API
info.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for internet kiosk businesses, admin console, kiosk portal, and machine (Chrome extension / desktop agent) endpoints.

device-token.description: Opaque device token issued at /devices/register. Used by machine clients only.

reviewer-token.description: Temporary token activated at /reviewer-access/redeem. Only accepted by /reviewer-public endpoints.

token.description: The token from the reset-password email link

alertKey.description: Stable id the frontend derives per Overview 'Needs attention' item, e.g. 'kiosk-inactive:<kioskId>' or 'payouts-pending'

disabled.description: Set true to disable this admin, false to re-enable

revenueSharePct.description: Percentage of commission the kiosk keeps (0-100, in 5% increments)

owner.description: The kiosk-owner account created in the same transaction, a password is generated server-side, emailed to them, and returned once in the response for the admin to share.

revenueSharePct.description: Percentage of commission the kiosk keeps (0-100, in 5% increments)

managedLocationIds.description: Location ids this user manages. Only meaningful for LOCATION_MANAGER

email.description: Changing this changes the address the account signs in with. Must not already be in use.

kioskId.description: Required when the caller is ADMIN; ignored for KIOSK_OWNER (their own kioskId is always used)

active.description: Set false to revoke the code, true to reactivate it

setupCode.description: Reusable per-location setup code generated by the kiosk owner/admin

hostname.description: Falls back to this if no label is given

deviceIdentifier.description: Agent-generated local UUID (device.json). Stored for support/audit correlation only, not used for dedup logic

active.description: Kill-switch. False immediately blocks this device's token

apiCredentials.description: Raw credentials (e.g. { apiKey, apiSecret }). Encrypted before storage, never returned by any read endpoint

hasCouponApi.description: Explicit flag: can this program feed coupon codes automatically?

apiCredentials.description: Replaces any existing stored credentials entirely. Re-encrypted before storage

removeCouponSelector.description: Required and nonblank when couponApplyMode is remove.

affiliateSubIdParamKey.description: Network-approved sub-ID query parameter for device commission attribution

attributionMethod.description: Required even if the store has no coupon API at all. This is what makes commission tracking work

affiliateTrackingUrl.description: Required if attributionMethod is COOKIE or BOTH

affiliateUrlParamKey.description: Required if attributionMethod is URL_PARAM or BOTH

affiliateUrlParamValue.description: Required if attributionMethod is URL_PARAM or BOTH

affiliateProgramId.description: Optional coupon-sourcing config. Connects this merchant to an existing affiliate program

codeSelector.description: CSS selector matching each coupon code element on the page

descriptionSelector.description: CSS selector for a description near each code, if present

revealSelector.description: CSS selector matching a "reveal"/"get code" button that must be clicked before the code becomes visible in the page. Only needed on sites that hide the code behind a click.

rowSelector.description: CSS selector matching each row container on a multi-merchant page (e.g. a site-wide "recently verified" feed covering many stores in one page, rather than one store per page). When set, this source must omit merchantId on the ScrapeSource itself -- codeSelector and merchantSelector are then evaluated per-row (scoped to each row element, not the whole page) and the merchant is resolved by exact case-insensitive name match against existing merchants; rows with no match are skipped rather than guessed.

merchantSelector.description: CSS selector for the merchant name within a rowSelector row. Required together with rowSelector; meaningless without it.

merchantId.description: The merchant this scrape source belongs to. Required unless selectorConfig.rowSelector is set (a multi-merchant source resolves the merchant per row instead).

intervalMinutes.description: Scrape cadence in minutes. Defaults to daily (1440)

kioskStatus.description: Status of the kiosk this device belongs to

deviceActive.description: Whether this specific device is enabled (kill-switch)

lifetimeSaved.description: Sum of confirmed discount amounts across every "applied" coupon-test-event for this device

layout.description: Freeform canvas design (AnnouncementLayout). Null for announcements authored before the canvas editor. The agent renders a default layout from title/body/mediaUrl in that case.

imageSmallUrl.description: 320x100 creative, rendered in the extension popup

imageLargeUrl.description: 728x90 leaderboard creative. Returned so the future on-page banner surface needs no API change

clickUrl.description: Where the shopper lands on click

eventId.description: Idempotency UUID, retained across reporting retries

isFinal.description: Final selection; trial success was already reported as valid

couponId.description: Nullable, a step-down suppression or a manual trigger with no matching coupon has no couponId

discountAmount.description: Confirmed cart-total delta for an "applied" result. Ignored for any other result

subId.description: Mint into the merchant's affiliateSubIdParamKey query param

kioskId.description: Which kiosk this announcement belongs to. Required for ADMIN unless `broadcast` is true; ignored for KIOSK_OWNER (their own kioskId is always used).

broadcast.description: ADMIN-only: create a platform-wide broadcast shown on every device across every kiosk, instead of one kiosk. An explicit flag rather than inferring broadcast from an omitted kioskId, since a forgotten kioskId silently becoming "show to everyone" is too large a blast radius for an implicit default. When true, kioskId and locationIds are ignored, a broadcast always targets everyone.

locationIds.description: Location ids to scope this announcement to; empty/omitted = all locations for the kiosk

body.description: Internal note, shown only in the dashboard list so an announcement is findable later. It is never drawn on the kiosk: what a kiosk shows comes entirely from `layout`. It was required and labelled "Body", which read like copy that would appear on screen.

layout.description: Freeform canvas design produced by the portal editor (AnnouncementLayout). Omit for a plain title/body/image announcement. The kiosk agent then renders a default layout built from those fields instead.

maxDisplayCount.description: Required (and must be >= 1) when repeatPolicy is MAX_N_TIMES. Enforced in AnnouncementsService, since it depends on the resolved repeatPolicy. Whenever supplied, regardless of repeatPolicy, must be a positive integer.

url.description: Absolute URL of the uploaded image. Use it as mediaUrl.

name.description: Internal label used to identify this promotion in the admin list. Never shown to shoppers.

imageSmallUrl.description: Absolute URL of the 320x100 creative, rendered in the extension popup. Get one from POST /promotions/upload-image?size=small.

imageLargeUrl.description: Absolute URL of the 728x90 creative, held for the future on-page banner surface. Get one from POST /promotions/upload-image?size=large.

clickUrl.description: Where the shopper lands when they click the promotion.

targetTags.description: Location tags to target, matched against Location.tags. Combined with locationIds as a union (either may match), not an intersection. Both empty = show on every device.

locationIds.description: Specific location ids to target. Combined with targetTags as a union. See above.

active.description: Manual kill switch, independent of the startAt/endAt window. Set false to pull a promotion without editing its schedule.

url.description: Absolute URL of the uploaded image. Use it as imageSmallUrl or imageLargeUrl.

width.description: Detected pixel width of the uploaded image.

height.description: Detected pixel height of the uploaded image.

name.description: Internal label used to identify this promotion in the admin list. Never shown to shoppers.

imageSmallUrl.description: Absolute URL of the 320x100 creative, rendered in the extension popup. Get one from POST /promotions/upload-image?size=small.

imageLargeUrl.description: Absolute URL of the 728x90 creative, held for the future on-page banner surface. Get one from POST /promotions/upload-image?size=large.

clickUrl.description: Where the shopper lands when they click the promotion.

targetTags.description: Location tags to target, matched against Location.tags. Combined with locationIds as a union (either may match), not an intersection. Both empty = show on every device.

locationIds.description: Specific location ids to target. Combined with targetTags as a union. See above.

active.description: Manual kill switch, independent of the startAt/endAt window. Set false to pull a promotion without editing its schedule.

kioskShareAmount.description: Finalized only once status is CONFIRMED; 0 otherwise

ingested.description: New CommissionEvents created (PENDING, or immediately CONFIRMED/REVERSED)

pendingAmount.description: Estimated kiosk share of still-PENDING commission. Informational, not withdrawable

confirmedAvailableAmount.description: Sum of CONFIRMED kioskShareAmount not yet included in a payout. This is the withdrawable balance

stripeConnected.description: True once the kiosk has connected a Stripe account (may still be mid-onboarding)

stripePayoutsEnabled.description: True once Stripe onboarding is fully complete and the account can receive transfers

url.description: Stripe-hosted Connect Express onboarding URL. Single-use, short-lived

supportEmail.description: The address the kiosk portal points owners and managers at. Send an empty string to clear it, which makes the portal render the text unlinked.
